summary: M3 Project-Aware AI validated end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 in-process tests pass (test_m3_project_ai.py, LLM mocked), 9/9 new HTTP-through-ingress tests pass (test_m3_http.py, LIVE Claude Sonnet 4.6 via emergentintegrations, ~5min). Covered: Sources CRUD (url/text/validation/list/delete), research singleton + status auto-advance idea->researching + activity 'research_generated', directions generation returns 2-4 items with all required fields (angle/audience_takeaway/format/tone/why_it_works) + PUT selected persists direction singleton + status developing, outline singleton + status writing, content NEVER overwrites (new object each call) + type mapping (youtube_video/instagram_reel->script, instagram_post->caption, instagram_carousel->carousel), edit rewrite/improve_hook return proposal WITHOUT mutating DB, critique returns strengths/weaknesses/suggestions, unknown action->400, chat persists user+assistant turns in order, ownership isolation on ALL 11 M3 endpoints returns 404 for foreign creator. Frontend E2E on live URL: created youtube project, brief topic saved, Research tab -> add text source visible in sources-list -> ran LIVE research question 'What is the strongest angle?', research-editor rendered ~30s. Direction tab -> generated 3 direction options, selected option-0, direction-selected rendered. Content tab -> ai-outline generated outline object, ai-content generated a script creative-object; second ai-content generated a SECOND script (never overwrote first) — confirmed 2 creative-object-<uuid> nodes. Edit action: ai-improve-hook-btn on first draft rendered proposal-<id> preview with explicit Accept/Discard — clicked Discard, original content untouched. Assistant sidebar: sent 'What is this project about?' — reply mentions the topic 'AI agents replacing human hires' AND objective 'Test M3' AND current status 'writing stage' (strong context awareness). Chat history persists across reload. All required data-testids present.
critical_code_review_comments: Singleton upsert for research/direction/outline is implemented correctly by scanning existing objects of that type in _upsert_singleton_creative_object; content generation explicitly creates a new CreativeObject each call — matches the 'never destroy creator work' contract.
Ownership check via _require_owned_project uses (project_id + creator_id) filter; returns 404 on foreign rows without leaking existence — verified on 11 endpoints.

AI failure paths (edit/research) do NOT touch prior CreativeObjects — verified by in-process fail injection. Chat failure persists user turn AND a visible '(assistant temporarily unavailable — ...)' assistant marker, then re-raises 502.
Rate limits present (project_ai_generate/project_ai_chat) — not stressed under this iteration since one user only.
ProjectAI.jsx is 905 lines; borderline against the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting ResearchTab / DirectionTab / ContentTab / ProjectAssistant into separate files for maintainability.
Proposal preview has explicit proposal-accept-{id} and proposal-discard-{id} — no silent overwrites in the UI. Confirmed by clicking Discard and re-reading DB content.
